title: TaskRevisionManifestV1
description: Canonical Task Revision manifest. `contentSha256` is the SHA-256 of the compact canonical JSON built from `schemaVersion` plus the bytewise-sorted `files` array (summary is excluded from source identity). Both the TypeScript and Python canonicalizers MUST produce byte-identical canonical JSON and digests for every fixture under cases/.

schemaVersion.description: Manifest contract version. Bumped only on a breaking change to the canonical form.

files.description: Every included regular/executable file, sorted by the bytewise UTF-8 ordering of its normalized (NFC, POSIX-separated) relative path. No duplicates after normalization.

summary.description: Bounded counts only — never secret filenames, never the full manifest. Not part of content identity.

path.description: Relative POSIX path, NFC-normalized. No leading slash, no '.', no '..' segments, no backslashes.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the exact file bytes.
